facts.end_use: spark ignition internal combustion piston engines

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8409 covers parts suitable for use solely or principally with engines of 8407/8408; Section XVI note 2(b) places parts of this kind in the engine heading
GRI 6: 8409.91 spark-ignition piston engines, other, other

rejected_alternatives.reason: crankshaft itself is transmission shaft; a sensing blade is not a crankshaft
blade is a passive part, not an electrical sensor (966732 concerned active speed sensors)

classification.rationale: A blade used in spark-ignition piston engines is a part of such engines under heading 8409 (Section XVI note 2(b)); G86626 classified an engine part under 8409.91.9990 on the same reasoning.
